preceding_probes.role: older rank-eight gamma-through-2 calibration pilot; incomparable fit grid
six-exposed-case negative causal readout result; replication motivation

provenance.observer_protocol: replay exact ROC02C 80-update gamma0 and chosen-gamma fits; same original trained model, identical initial U, independent per-seed gamma chosen earlier on calibration; verify saved per-seed MSE and null B before any intervention analysis

data.rows: all 256 previously exposed calibration records in original fixed order, with label/oracle verification; report any missing or invalid
data.sealed_policy: ABSOLUTE EXCLUSION: do not load, inspect, generate, infer, score or use family-6/7 sealed inputs or outputs
data.confirmation_scope: calibration-only; observer hyperparameters were chosen using this family, so prospective source-generalization is NOT assessed

legal_counterfactuals.source_A_rule: For family 4 (3x+1 mod8) or family 5 (3x+5 mod8), exchange only initial A binding table 4<->5; preserve later events, query, distractors, delay; independently recompute yprime=(y+4)%8 with symbolic_execute
legal_counterfactuals.query_cue: Change only final query value q to (q+4)%8; preserve initial A binding, all carry and distractors; independently recompute yprime=(y+4)%8
legal_counterfactuals.target_match: For each record both legal edits must have the same exact new label yprime, distinct from original y; reject any failure
legal_counterfactuals.optional_negative: For any example with B/C distractor, change one distractor binding to alternate dev rule table while preserving answer; count availability and report separately
legal_counterfactuals.discrete_costs: Publish both raw source-feature L2 and resulting midpoint-state L2; full legal edits remain unmatched-dose descriptive controls

physical_matching.insertion_point: after all input events and depth/2 tied residual updates, before remaining depth/2 updates
physical_matching.interpolated_input: x(t)=x0+t*(x_legal-x0), t in [0,1] for each of the two legal edit types; bisection to physical midpoint norm r; these soft feature vectors are off the discrete source manifold and have no symbolic label
physical_matching.interpolation_solver: fixed grid t=j/64, j=0..64; bracket first radius crossing, then 24 bisection iterations; require absolute midpoint radius error <=2e-5; mark unreachable rather than clipping
hidden_directions: U U^T (h_legal-h0), normalized to r (observed rule/cue)
seeded rank-matched random observed unit direction, normalized to r
seeded isotropic random hidden unit direction, normalized to r
physical_matching.parity: all hidden arms and input interpolation start from identical original h_mid; compare outputs after same tied suffix and fixed readout; report every norm error, invalid projection and unreachable input
physical_matching.no_saved_adapter: ROC02C PR144 only publishes optimizer receipts, so U and train-only ridge heads must be deterministically reconstructed and validated against original per-seed published calibration rows; never substitute older PR127 adapters

endpoints.primary: Original frozen model final logits: signed target-vs-original margin gain g=(z_post[yprime]-z_post[y])-(z_base[yprime]-z_base[y]) under the observed projection of legal source-rule delta, at radius 0.2
endpoints.matched_comparators: The larger of legal-rule soft input, legal-query soft input, task-only observed source steering and isotropic hidden steering at exactly the same midpoint radius; report each component before taking any best
endpoints.paired_observer_effect: For each seed, mean over the same 256 calibration cases of g_joint_observed_rule minus g_task_only_observed_rule; depth16/rank7/radius0.20 is the single preregistered primary descriptive contrast
endpoints.observer_secondary: Frozen rank-k train-only ridge scores on midpoint states: signed target-vs-original score margin gain, with scores divided by train-only target-pair SD; raw score L2, delta logits L2, and target accuracy also reported
endpoints.task_specificity: Report source-rule and query-cue interventions separately even though their exact target labels agree; report label-preserving distractor controls where available
endpoints.original_model_accuracy: Report native task accuracy on untouched calibration cases and source-change correct-target accuracy; low performance is a negative interpretability limit

statistics.unit_of_replication: six model initialization seeds per depth; 256 paired dev records are within-seed observations and may share rule-family structure
statistics.primary_test: enumerate all 2^6 sign flips of the six paired seed-mean effects; one-sided exact randomization p, with directional seed count and effect sizes; calibration-selection exposure prohibits a prospective held-out inference
statistics.secondary_tests: depth8, rank8 and radii .05/.10 and other edit controls descriptive; any formal multi-endpoint claim requires prespecified familywise control, and ROC01 per-state mechanism tags retain the six-test Holm correction
statistics.minimum_reporting: full per-case effect data; 24 model-rank seed means; family4/5 strata; per-seed paired differences; radius eligibility and invalids; raw-vs-normalized readout scales
statistics.prospective_gate: Keep sealed test shut; no ROC-01 complete mechanism classification, Chernoff type allocation, or source-generalization claim from ROC02E alone

abort_on: original model or train/calibration source hash mismatch
prior ROC02C gamma or replay-metric mismatch
checks.freeze: This registration is committed before any ROC02E calibration intervention measurements
